why: Expression cycle 17 (docs/v3/cycles/expression-17.md) lost 20 of its 46 round-0 points to the kit (class `primitive`), one P2 among them: at 390 n82's 'Daily counts' plot, its top 2 px under the fold, moves 3 px when the keys or the pointer bring the focus to it (R3 1, the cycle's only rendering cap, .14); the quality matrix's hover guard fails n82 at 390 for the same move, and its waiver list (`KNOWN_SHIFTS`) lives in the package, so a cycle cannot waive it. The rest are P3s that recur on two or more cases: unfocused ink-step bars that barely recede (n81, n82; open since cycle 16's n75 and n76), a clamp caret too faint on an ink-step bar (n81, n82), a delta pill that draws a trend arrow on an unsigned count or share (n81 '2 of 3 scheduled', n86 '53 % of all'), value labels a reference rule strikes (n82's typical-day rule through a '0', n84's 'No report' rule through 'US$1,832' at 390), a blank band beside or inside a card at 1800 (n82, n84, n85), a `DataPanel` that holds fewer rows than it declares (n82 at 1800 under a fixture, n86 at 390), mono ids that break at a hyphen in phone rows (n84 'atlas-fast', n86 'unused-exports'). Every builder's `scenarios.test.ts` run failed for a while because `c.date` types `style: 'day'` (`DateStyle`) and its runtime option check rejects it (packages/basalt-ui/src/table/core/kinds.tsx OPTION_VALUES style); n81 and n84 dropped the style. The lead's probe on master de90a22e (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-17/probe/verdicts.md` in the main checkout) found v3-expr-16-kit-fixes landed in part: unfocused ink-step bars still do not recede (n75, n76 SWEEP counters 0); at 390 n76's '330' and '333' touch and n70's '100 %' straddles its bar's top; n76 `?fixture=finished` still leaves about 40 px between the right-hand cards and n70's ledger about 165 px under its last row; n79 `?fixture=surge` end labels share one rule with no leader each and lines strike three; n71's 'Not counted' is not drawn under `?fixture=few` and n68's zone caption is dropped at 390; n72's direct labels sit on dots at 390; n61's held run is not in view among its 390 phone cards. Issue 2696 (open when this cycle ran) took the n79 end labels, the n71 inset, the DataPanel loading skeleton at 390 and n57; read its outcome first and leave what it shipped.
what: Kit behaviour fixes for the primitive findings of expression cycle 17 and the gaps of v3-expr-16-kit-fixes that landed in part, with no export and no contract change.

(2) Unfocused ink-step bars visibly recede when one bar takes the focus (n81, n82; probe n75, n76 SWEEP counters 0), open since cycle 16 change (6). (3) A clamp caret reads on an ink-step bar (n81's 'None' 23 at an 8 ceiling, n82's 500-vote bar): enough contrast to see the break at both widths and schemes. (4) A delta pill draws no trend arrow for a value that carries no sign (a count, a share or a word such as '2 of 3 scheduled' or '53 % of all'; `directionOf` in ui/badge.tsx reads it as up), n81, n86. (5) A data or value label that a reference rule or its caption crosses moves or the rule gives way: n82 `?fixture=quiet` (the typical-day rule through the '0' at Now), n84 `?fixture=spike` at 390 ('No report' through 'US$1,832'). (6) A card stretched to its row, or a short column beside a taller one, puts its extra height below its content, not as a band inside or beside it: n82, n84, n85 at 1800; probe n70 (about 165 px), n76 `?fixture=finished` (about 40 px). If this needs a size field, it waits for the cards size-hint Spec that Issue 2696 raised (`DataPanel cardHeight`, `StatCard chartHeight`): do not add one here. (7) A `DataPanel` rows body holds every row it declares, whole: n82 `?fixture=spike` cuts its fourth row at 1800 in a rows-5 box, n86 shows 13 of 17 at 390 where wrapped ids make rows taller than the declared row. (8) A mono id in a phone row does not break at a hyphen ('atlas-fast', 'unused-exports'), n84, n86. (9) `c.date` accepts every `DateStyle` it types, 'day' included (kinds.tsx OPTION_VALUES), with a test, so no builder's scenarios.test.ts run fails on a typed option. (10) One-case defects of shipped parts: a line pane and a bar pane of one card place the same day half a slot apart (n84: the 6 to 16 Nov band at 810 to 1153 against 795 to 1126 at 1800); a `BarList` focus clears while the pointer rests in a row at 1800 dark (n85 SWEEP: 0 dimmed at gap +400 ms). (11) The probe's open gaps of v3-expr-16-kit-fixes not taken by Issue 2696: at 390 two bar values keep apart and a '100 %' label sits whole above or inside its bar (n76 `?fixture=spike`, n70); a zone caption is kept on bars at 390 and on a narrow zone (n68 at 390, n71 `?fixture=few`); a direct label on a dot chart at 390 keeps off other dots (n72); a held run is in view among 390 phone cards (n61).
